SELECT `object_id` as `id`, `object_name` as `name`, `category_code`, `category_name`, COUNT(1) as `num`, max(`maintenance_finish_time`) `last_time` FROM `maintenance_tasks`
`maintenance_finish_time` is not null
and `object_name` like concat('%',#{param.keyword},'%')
and `category_code` like concat('%',#{param.categoryCode},'%')
and `maintenance_time` between #{param.period.begin} and #{param.period.end}
GROUP BY `object_id`,`object_name`,`category_code`,`category_name` order by max(`maintenance_finish_time`) desc

SELECT COUNT( id ) FROM maintenance_tasks where maintenance_task_status = #{status}

SELECT maintenance_task_person_id as keyId, maintenance_task_person as keyName, COUNT( id ) as finished FROM maintenance_tasks WHERE maintenance_task_status = #{status} GROUP BY maintenance_task_person_id

SELECT temp.person_id AS keyId, COUNT( mp.ID ) AS unfinished FROM maintenance_plan mp LEFT JOIN maintenance_tasks mt ON mp.id = mt.plan_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX( SUBSTRING_INDEX( t.responsibility_person_id, '-', n.n ), '-', - 1 ) AS person_id FROM maintenance_plan t JOIN ( SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 ) n -- 假设最多5个ID用-分隔 ON LENGTH( t.responsibility_person_id ) - LENGTH( REPLACE ( t.responsibility_person_id, '-', '' )) >= n.n - 1 WHERE t.responsibility_person_id IS NOT NULL AND t.responsibility_person_id != '' GROUP BY person_id ) temp ON mp.responsibility_person_id LIKE CONCAT( '%', temp.person_id, '%' ) WHERE mt.maintenance_task_status = 'BE_MAINTAINED' GROUP BY temp.person_id
SELECT object_id AS key_id, object_name AS key_name, COUNT( id ) AS finished FROM maintenance_tasks WHERE maintenance_task_status = #{status} GROUP BY object_id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT( `maintenance_finish_time`, '%H' ) AS `time`, COUNT( id ) AS `count` FROM maintenance_tasks WHERE maintenance_task_status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT( `maintenance_finish_time`, '%H' ) ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(`maintenance_finish_time`,'%H')
